name: Eagle Ridge Golf Course
editorNote: Eagle Ridge is an 18-hole public course in Boneo, away from the Cape Schanck and Rye links cluster. The club welcomes golfers of different abilities and links directly to online tee-time booking. Compare the live times and variable prices with your preferred travel day; the club is a separate drive from the coastal courses.
